brand.purpose: The SYNTHONOS wordmark only, Michroma over its rainbow stripe quote.

silk-title.purpose: Section legends printed across their frame rules.

silk-fine.purpose: Model plate, spec line, sound counts, micro-legends.

body.purpose: Everything the product says: buttons, hints, tooltips, responses.

sentence.purpose: The describe input, Barlow 15px #f4f2ea; ratified amendment, deliberately no italic serif.

data.purpose: Every measured value: readouts, scales, key letters, signal path. Variable 400-600.

led14.purpose: The patch window: what the machine is holding, said in light.

shadows.name: machined
shadows.purpose: The one machined edge: hairline top light on every mounted panel (with its 1px black seam border).

shadows.name: cap-ledge
shadows.purpose: Switch cap at rest: top light plus the 1px dark ledge below.

shadows.name: cap-seated
shadows.purpose: Pressed or current cap: traveled 1px and seated.

shadows.name: glass-inset
shadows.purpose: The display glass recess; wells use inset 0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.55), LED windows inset 0 2px 7px rgba(0,0,0,0.8).

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: True overlays only: describe response (settings 0 12px 32px, match drawer 0 14px 34px).

shadows.name: machine-glow
shadows.purpose: Law 2 state signal: the machine is turning this knob (arc to full opacity, 300ms tween + 400ms linger).

shadows.name: led-glow
shadows.purpose: LED segments and dots; amber commits glow 0 0 9px rgba(255,176,58,0.32).

motion.name: panel-seat
motion.purpose: Power-on: the five panels seat upward in sequence.

motion.name: band-wipe
motion.purpose: Power-on: rainbow band (and brand stripes at 0.55s) wipe in from the left.

motion.name: arc-up
motion.purpose: Power-on: knob arcs fade up last.

motion.name: tri-sweep
motion.purpose: Describe hairline while the machine thinks.

motion.name: band-chase
motion.purpose: Rainbow band light chase while data-shaping is set.

motion.name: led-blink
motion.purpose: Shape switch LED while the machine thinks.

motion.name: led-marquee
motion.purpose: Patch names longer than the glass scroll like a real 1982 display.

motion.name: knob-tween
motion.value: 300ms cubic ease-out + 400ms glow linger (in Knob.tsx, not CSS)

motion.name: state-fade
motion.purpose: Hover background and color shifts on caps and arcs.

components.name: Switch Cap
components.description: Every button is a tactile cap: gradient face, black seam, top light, 1px ledge; pressing travels it 1px and seats it.
components.css: .ds-cap { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #242428, #1d1d20); color: #a9a79f; border: 1px solid #000; border-radius: 2px; padding: 5px 12px; font-family: 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.07), 0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.7); transition: background 0.1s ease-out, color 0.1s ease-out; } .ds-cap:hover { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #2b2b30, #232327); color: #eae8e1; } .ds-cap:active { transform: translateY(1px); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); } .ds-cap:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffb03a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Commit Switch
components.description: An armed switch is backlit amber with near-black amber ink; the backlight is earned (Save sits unlit until named).
components.css: .ds-cap-commit { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #ffb03a; color: #241703; border: 1px solid #000; border-radius: 2px; padding: 5px 12px; font-family: 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.35), 0 0 9px rgba(255,176,58,0.32); transition: background 0.1s ease-out; } .ds-cap-commit:hover { background: #ffc05e; } .ds-cap-commit:active { transform: translateY(1px); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); } .ds-cap-commit:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffb03a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Shape Switch
components.description: The front door's commit: amber backlight plus the one red LED, lit when armed, blinking while the machine thinks.
components.css: .ds-cap-shape { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; background: #ffb03a; color: #241703; border: 1px solid #000; border-radius: 2px; padding: 7px 15px; font-family: 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.35), 0 0 9px rgba(255,176,58,0.32); } .ds-cap-shape:hover { background: #ffc05e; } .ds-led-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #ff3b2e; box-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(255,59,46,0.65); }

components.name: Well Input
components.description: Recessed well slot for names; the describe lane is the same glass at 15px with its rainbow hairline.
components.css: .ds-well { background: #0b0b0d; color: #eae8e1; caret-color: #ffb03a; border: 1px solid #000; border-radius: 2px; padding: 6px 9px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); font-family: 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; } .ds-well::placeholder { color: #83817a; } .ds-well:focus { outline: none; border-color: #2e2e33; } .ds-well::selection { background: rgba(255,176,58,0.35); }

components.name: LED Display
components.description: The patch window: red DSEG segments on deep glass, ghost segments behind, marquee for long names.
components.css: .ds-led { position: relative; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; background: #050506; border: 1px solid #000; border-radius: 2px; padding: 8px 12px 6px; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 7px rgba(0,0,0,0.8); font-family: 'DSEG14 Classic', 'Spline Sans Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; min-width: 180px; } .ds-led-ghost { position: absolute; inset: 8px 12px 6px; overflow: hidden; color: rgba(255,59,46,0.14); pointer-events: none; } .ds-led-msg { position: relative; color: #ff3b2e; text-shadow: 0 0 7px rgba(255,59,46,0.65); }

components.name: Silk Rule
components.description: The navigation: a condensed uppercase legend interrupting its 1px frame rule, fine print pinned right.
components.html: Patch Bank41 sounds · every one a starting point
components.css: .ds-silk { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-width: 320px; } .ds-silk-title { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Barlow', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #eae8e1; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-silk-line { flex: 1; height: 1px; background: rgba(234,232,225,0.13); } .ds-silk-fine { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Barlow', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #83817a; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Patch Cap
components.description: A preset as a named switch cap; the loaded cap sits seated with its LED lit.
components.css: .ds-patch { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #242428, #1d1d20); color: #a9a79f; border: 1px solid #000; border-radius: 2px; padding: 6px 12px; font-family: 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.07), 0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.7); } .ds-patch:hover { color: #eae8e1; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #2b2b30, #232327); } .ds-patch-led { width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255,59,46,0.14); } .ds-patch-current { background: #2a2a2e; color: #eae8e1; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); } .ds-patch-current .ds-patch-led { background: #ff3b2e; box-shadow: 0 0 4px rgba(255,59,46,0.65); }

components.name: Category Switch
components.description: Category selector wearing its sharp ink square; the chosen one is backlit amber.
components.css: .ds-bcat { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 3px 9px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #242428, #1d1d20); border: 1px solid #000; border-radius: 2px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.07), 0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.7); font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.13em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #a9a79f; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-bcat:hover { color: #eae8e1; } .ds-bcat-ink { width: 7px; height: 7px; } .ds-bcat-selected { background: #ffb03a; color: #241703; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.35), 0 0 8px rgba(255,176,58,0.32); }

components.name: Macro Name Plate
components.description: Each macro's name silkscreened as near-black caps on a block of its own ink (Law 3).
components.css: .ds-plate { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 9px 1px; background: var(--ink, #8f8d85); color: #0b0b0c; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Rainbow Band
components.description: The signature: eight 2px pinstripes, one per macro ink, red to magenta, separated by 1px steel; runs a white light chase while the machine shapes.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: Plain words on hover, everywhere; speech, not silkscreen.
components.html: How quickly a note reaches full volume.
components.css: .ds-tip { display: inline-block; max-width: 230px; padding: 6px 10px; background: #2a2a2e; border: 1px solid #3a3a40; border-radius: 2px; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.55); color: #eae8e1; font-family: 'Barlow', sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px; line-height: 1.4; }

narrative.overview: Synthonos wears the front panel of a 1982 polyphonic flagship, in the Roland Jupiter-8's own grammar. One matte black painted-steel face carries everything: white silkscreen legends and 1px frame rules explain the machine the way hardware explains itself, tactile switch caps travel when pressed, and red LED segment displays say what the machine is holding. Three material laws govern the surface. Law 1, steel mounting: depth is machined, not floated; a 1px black panel gap and a hairline top highlight, never a drop shadow at rest. Law 2, the machine speaks in light: LED displays carry what the machine is saying, an armed switch is backlit amber, and a knob the machine turns burns its ink while it moves. Law 3, indexed ink: the eight macro inks are the whole palette, laid out once in the rainbow pinstripe band over the keybed; every colored mark on the panel is one of those eight inks doing a job.
keyCharacteristics: One continuous painted-steel face; regions drawn by silkscreen frames and rules, never cards
Eight indexed inks, laid out once in the rainbow band, reused for every colored mark on the panel
Two lights with fixed meanings: red LED for what the machine says, amber backlight for what is armed or selected
Silkscreen realness: printed dial rings, dB/Hz/ms-DIV scales, calibration fine print, a model plate
Switch caps that travel 1px and seat when pressed; LED displays with ghost segments and a marquee
A power-on sequence: panels seat, the rainbow wipes in, the LED displays flicker alive

rules.name: The Indexed Ink Rule
rules.body: The eight macro inks are the entire chromatic palette. Before coloring anything, name which ink it is and what job that ink is doing (macro, rack group, category, band); if there is no answer, use steel or silkscreen. New hues do not exist.

rules.name: The Two Lights Rule
rules.body: Red LED means the machine is speaking or holding something (displays, lit dots, held keys). Amber means armed, selected, or ready to commit. Neither is ever decoration, and no other color glows.

rules.name: The Rainbow Signature Rule
rules.body: The full eight-ink sweep appears in exactly three places: the pinstripe band over the keybed (the flagship's own placement), the small stripe quote under the wordmark, and the hairline under the describe sentence. Never anywhere else.

rules.name: The Silkscreen/Speech/Segment Rule
rules.body: Legends printed on the panel are condensed tracked uppercase; words the product says are Barlow sentence case; values the machine measures are Spline Sans Mono; values the machine displays are DSEG in LED red. Never mix within one string.

rules.name: The Machined Edge Rule
rules.body: If it is mounted on the panel, it gets the seam-and-hairline construction and no shadow. If it floats over the panel, it gets a real offset shadow. There is no third state.

rules.name: The Light-Means-Work Rule
rules.body: Glow is a state signal, never a material: LED glow, amber backlight glow, and the machine-glow on a moving knob arc are the only luminous things on the face.

dos: Do build every mounted element from the one construction: steel gradient or flat steel, 1px black seam, machined hairline; recess anything that displays or receives content into screen or well glass with an inset shadow.
Do index every color: each colored mark is one of the eight macro inks doing a named job, or one of the two lights doing its fixed job (red = the machine speaking, amber = armed or selected).
Do set legends in condensed tracked uppercase, speech in Barlow, measurements in Spline Sans Mono, and machine-held values in DSEG with ghost segments behind them.
Do keep the machine-glow: any programmatic parameter change tweens its knob over 300ms and burns the arc's ink (plus 400ms linger) while it moves.
Do make backlight earned: a commit switch stays unlit until there is something to commit.
Do write UI copy in plain musician words ("open the full rack", "a starting point, not a copy"), never engineering abbreviations.
Do honor the power-on sequence for new panels (seat, wipe, flicker) and collapse everything under prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't add drop shadows to resting surfaces, cards, or any rounded-corner radius above 3px on mounted parts (scrollbar, armed pill, and true circles are the only exceptions).
Don't invent hues outside the eight inks and two lights, and don't let any ink glow decoratively; glow is reserved for the machine's own light and work.
Don't use the rainbow sweep outside its three seats: the band over the keys, the brand quote, the describe hairline (The Rainbow Signature Rule).
Don't put an italic serif (or any serif) in the describe lane or anywhere else; the ratified amendment sets the human sentence in Barlow 15px warmth. 1982 silkscreen had no serifs.
Don't render "80s" as synthwave neon, grids, chrome, or bloom; the world is matte steel and printed ink, not backlit plastic.
Don't color the waveform trace by frequency; time is not frequency, and the scope stays single-hue green phosphor.
